'''Bianca's Oshawott''' (Japanese: '''ベルのミジュマル''' ''Bel's Mijumaru'') is the Pokémon given to {{adv|Bianca}} by [[Professor Juniper]] in the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==In the Pokémon Adventures manga==
===History===
===={{MangaArc|Black & White}}====
[[File:Bianca Oshawott angry.png|thumb|200px|left|Oshawott enraged]]
Oshawott first appeared in ''[[PS461|Fussing and Fighting]]'', as one of the Pokémon owned by [[Professor Juniper]] along with the other [[Unova]] first partner Pokémon, {{TP|Cheren|Snivy}} and [[Bo|Tepig]]. After {{p|Tepig}} gets into a fight with {{p|Snivy}}, Oshawott unsuccessfully tries to get them to stop and constantly gets hit in the process. After being sent flying into a wall, Oshawott's anger reaches its boiling point and begins attacking Tepig and Snivy, forcing them to use any object in Professor Juniper's lab they could find to protect themselves. Eventually, Professor Juniper finds the three in their violent tussle and sends them back into their {{i|Poké Ball}}s. The three sleep inside while Professor Juniper worriedly wonders if they are truly ready to be partners for the upcoming {{pkmn|Trainer}}s.

[[PS462|Later]], Oshawott, along with Tepig and Snivy, are sent to {{adv|Black}}'s home from the lab and the package soon reaches the boy's hands. Black's cold, which he got after staying in the rain while waiting for the package to come, causes him to sneeze and drop the box, releasing the Pokémon from their Poké Balls. Tepig and Snivy get into another fight which Oshawott once again tries to stop. Once again, Oshawott gets angry and violently attacks them. Tepig runs off and Black follows him, leaving Snivy at the mercy of Oshawott's rage. Later, Professor Juniper shockingly arrives to see the aftermath of the battle between Snivy and Oshawott. Next, {{adv|Bianca}} and {{adv|Cheren}} arrive wondering what had happened; while Professor Juniper worries about her broken [[Pokédex]]es, Bianca hands Cheren Snivy, stating that he resembled him, and takes Oshawott for herself.
[[File:Striaton Gym Battle Adventures.png|thumb|200px|Oshawott during the Striaton Gym]]
In ''[[PS469|Welcome To Striaton City!!]]'', after Bianca and Cheren arrive in [[Striaton City]] to tell Black to take care of his Pokédex, they get roped into his [[Gym]] battle. Oshawott, along with Snivy and Tepig, now named Tep, are used to battle the [[Gym Leader]]s, [[Cilan]], [[Chili]], and [[Cress]]. Before doing so, Oshawott is used to teach Bianca about Pokémon [[type]] compatibility by having Tep and Snivy attack him and teach Bianca which types are strong and weak against {{type|Water}} Pokémon. After passing through the Gym's challenge, they face the Gym Leaders. At first, Oshawott and the others are overpowered by the three Pokémon belonging to the Gym Leaders but eventually gain the upper hand when they use teamwork. Eventually, after blocking an attack by [[Cilan's Pansage]], Oshawott retaliates by throwing its [[Scalchop and seamitar|scalchop]] at [[Chili's Pansear]], defeating it. Immediately after this, Oshawott has his scalchop shattered by Pansage and is defeated. Luckily, Tep managed to grab some of Pansage's leaves and feeds them to Oshawott and Snivy, rejuvenating them. Just as they are revived, the match's time limit ends, allowing Black, Cheren, and Bianca to win with 3-2.

In ''[[PS500|With a Little Help from My Friends]]'', at [[Anville Town]], Oshawott helps Bianca practice the flute by holding up sheet music for her to play. When Bianca meets with {{adv|White}}, she reveals that her {{TP|Bianca|father}} had constantly been attempting to get her to return home. Due to her father's overprotective nature, Bianca was unable to train and become stronger, leaving Oshawott and {{p|Litwick}} unskilled in battling. Later, Oshawott was used alongside White's {{adv|Amanda}} to battle a wild {{p|Vullaby}} at the {{DL|Castelia City|Café Sonata}} to protect a wild {{p|Meloetta}}. Realizing that Vullaby's skull diaper was protecting a weak spot, White had Amanda distract Vullaby with {{m|Leaf Tornado}}, allowing Oshawott to throw its scalchop into the diaper undetected. This weakened Vullaby enough for Meloetta to defeat it, allowing White to catch and add it to her team.

After Bianca becomes Professor Juniper's assistant, Oshawott assists his Trainer with her work.

===={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}====
In ''[[PS541|Pink Slip]]'', Oshawott and Bianca listen on the radio to the towns frozen by the [[Plasma Frigate]].

In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', Bianca combined Oshawott's {{m|Water Pledge}} with the Fire Pledge from [[Benga]]'s {{p|Pignite}}, the {{m|Grass Pledge}} from Cheren's Servine, and the Water Pledge from [[Cedric Juniper]]'s {{p|Samurott}} to break through the ice covering the [[Marine Tube]], freeing Cheren and his class, who were trapped inside. Later, Oshawott, alongside the other eight Unova first partner Pokémon, fired their {{m|Water Pledge|Pledge}} moves at [[N's Castle]] to stop the fire caused by the Plasma Frigate.

===Personality and characteristics===
Oshawott is normally the calmer, shyer, and most peaceful of the three [[Unova first partner Pokémon]] that were supposed to go to {{adv|Bianca}}, {{adv|Black}}, and {{adv|Cheren}}. However, whenever Oshawott loses his temper, he takes on another personality and goes into a violent frenzy. When angered, he will attack anything in the vicinity, usually destroying or harming whatever or whoever is unlucky enough to be near him.

==In other manga==
===Be the Best! Pokémon B+W===
[[File:Bianca Samurott PBW.png|thumb|100px|Bianca's Samurott in Be the Best! Pokémon B+W]]
[[File:Bianca Oshawott PBW.png|thumb|left|100px|As an Oshawott]]
Bianca owns an Oshawott in [[Be the Best! Pokémon B+W]], where it serves as her first partner Pokémon. It first appears with its Trainer in ''[[PBW1|Advance Toward the Path of the Strongest!]]'', where it watches the battle with [[Monta]] and [[Cheren]] against the {{tc|Biker|Biker King}}.
In ''[[PBW8|The Birth of the Best Pokémon Trainer!]]'', it was revealed that Oshawott had evolved into a Samurott. Cheren borrows Samurott from Bianca and uses it along with his {{p|Emboar}} and [[Monta's Serperior]] in order to have a battle against Monta and his {{p|Zekrom}}, {{p|Victini}}, and {{p|Reshiram}}. Despite that it faced powerful Legendary and Mythical Pokémon, Samurott proved to be a powerful opponent. Eventually, it was defeated by Victini's {{m|Searing Shot}}.
